concerns.text: The control's 'small flat skin callus in my right palm below my ring finger' in a 66 year old man is a common description of an early palmar nodule of the same condition, so level 1 for the control is arguable; a clinician may want it examined (level 2).

concerns.text: 'Lower limb motor compulsion' is not a clinical term. The clinical criterion is itself 'an urge to move the legs', so the medical wording here is invented jargon rather than the clinical register.
